title: Software Engineer - Turso
text:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Turso core database team and help bring forward the future of agentic databases. Turso is both an Open Source database that replaces SQLite—with an ongoing project to also support the Postgres interface—and a Cloud offering where users can create databases on demand. You’ll work closely with customers and other teams at Supabase to build the future of what databases look like in a world where users and agents are creating millions of databases a day.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building database technology tools that scale to billions.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Driving the progress of the Turso Open Source database, in particular the Postgres compatibility layer.

 - Making sure code works, and never breaks, and putting the systems and guarantees in place for that to happen.

 - Maintaining the Turso Cloud operations, including the Cloud API and data plane operations.

 - Improving the scalability of the Turso Cloud operations to support a 100x larger number of databases


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have written databases before, and/or other high-stakes low-level systems like Hypervisors, OS Kernels, storage devices, etc.

 - Have experience working with remote teams and Open Source communities.

 - Have a passion and experience for correct systems that work, and have the experience in the tools to make that happen: Deterministic Simulation Testing, formal verification methods, fuzz and differential testing, etc.

 - Have experience deploying, operating and debugging large scale software systems in production in cloud environments such as AWS & Kubernetes

 - Have experience improving the observability, reliability and performance of complex cloud systems.

 - Are comfortable working in Rust.

 - Are comfortable with LLM-assisted development and evals.

 - Are comfortable working with Embedded databases.

 - Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

title: Platform & Security Engineer
text:
ABOUT ATLYS

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early. We’re now building AI-native products too, including agents that act on behalf of travellers.


THE ROLE

We're looking for a Platform & Security Engineer to own the foundations that keep Atlys fast, reliable and secure.

Not someone who simply keeps servers running or closes tickets from a scanner. We're looking for someone who treats infrastructure and security as products: who designs systems that are secure by default, automates away toil, and gives every engineer a paved road to ship safely.

Few companies handle data as sensitive as ours. Passports, financial documents, photographs and identity records flow every day between travellers, partners and government systems across 127 countries. You'll own the cloud infrastructure, security posture and reliability of the platform that processes it, and make sure it scales as we grow.

You’ll be the second engineer on our Infra & Security team. That means real ownership from week one: you’ll take over large parts of our infrastructure and security roadmap, not a narrow slice of it.

We don’t expect you to have done all of this before. We care far more about strong fundamentals and the ability to figure things out. You’ll have AI tools at your disposal and the room to learn whatever you haven’t touched yet.


THE JOB

 - Own our cloud infrastructure. Run and improve our Kubernetes platform on GCP (with some workloads on AWS). Make deployments repeatable and fast with multi-stage CI/CD, container promotion and GitOps.

 - Make the platform observable and reliable. Bring logs, metrics and traces into one place, set up alerting that people trust, and take part in on-call and incident response. Keep an eye on cloud cost and catch anomalies early.

 - Run our data layer. Own database performance optimizations, backups and access automation, along with caching and our messaging infrastructure.

 - Lock down access. Enforce least-privilege IAM across cloud, Kubernetes and GitHub. Run zero-trust access to internal services, SSO, and clean offboarding.

 - Protect sensitive data. Design and harden access controls and audit logging for PII such as passports, financial documents and identity records.

 - Build security into how we ship. Add SAST, DAST, dependency and container scanning, and SBOMs to CI/CD. Run vulnerability management and coordinate pentests. Find and validate application security issues (authorization, authentication, business logic, injection), drive fixes with service owners, and fix directly where it makes sense.

 - Secure our AI products. Threat-model and harden AI agents and assistants that act on users’ behalf: prompt injection, tool and OAuth scope permissions, data leakage between users, and secrets handling.


THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 4+ years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, security engineering, ideally at a product company handling sensitive or regulated data.

 - Have strong fundamentals in Linux, networking (DNS, TLS, HTTP, load balancing), containers and Kubernetes, and at least one public cloud.

 - Understand security fundamentals (identity and access, encryption, secrets management, the OWASP Top 10) and have applied them in production, not just on paper.

 - Are strong in either infrastructure or security, and genuinely want to get good at the other.

 - Take ownership end to end. You make pragmatic trade-offs between security, speed and developer experience. You explain risk clearly and bring engineers along rather than acting as a gatekeeper.

title: Network Engineer
text:
Join our forward-thinking team as a Network Engineer, where you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting high-performance, low-latency network infrastructure.
At IMC, the Trading Infrastructure team is responsible for the WAN, LANs, and all low-latency connectivity to trading venues. You will work closely with Systems Engineers, internal teams, and external partners to deliver best-in-class solutions that support our trading business and help evolve our infrastructure to meet the demands of a dynamic industry.

Your Core Responsibilities:

Design, implement and support the networking infrastructure. Key areas include Low-latency networking, Unicast and Multicast routing, OSPF, BGP, PIM SM, as well as things like QoS, STP, NAT, protocol tuning, etc.

Monitor, guard and analyze the proper functioning of our network infrastructure. Take adaptive, retentive and corrective measures and perform structural maintenance.

Proactively improve our infrastructure by contributing scripts and code to our automation efforts (e.g. Bash, Python).

Accurately create and maintain documentation detailing the implemented network components, as well as relevant procedures and other documentation.

Responsibility for our IT security related platforms. Key areas include Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs, Security policies, etc.

Work flexible hours. We are proud of the uptime of the trading environment, so every now and then you will be working outside of regular business hours to apply critical changes. This could be from your desk, your couch at home or also inside of one of our datacenters abroad.

Liaise with external vendors, exchanges and providers to explore new technology solutions, implement new services or troubleshoot problems.

Your Skills and Experience:

5+ years of experience as a Network Engineer, with a passion for all aspects of networking

Proven ability to design, implement, and support high-performance networks

Strong appetite for accuracy and willingness to go beyond standard textbook networking concepts

Collaborative mindset with experience working closely across cross-functional teams

Ability to motivate and encourage peers while maintaining a high technical standard

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

title: IT Systems Engineer
text:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

We are hiring a Senior IT Systems Engineer to own the identity, authentication, and automation layer of Baseten’s internal IT environment. You will design and maintain how employees access every system at the company, from the day they’re hired to the day they leave.

This is a senior individual contributor role focused on engineering, not frontline support. You will lead our Okta environment, build automated workflows that replace manual IT processes, and partner closely with Security to enforce access controls as we scale. You will also serve as a technical escalation point for the IT Support team on complex identity and systems issues.

This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco or New York office, following our standard policy of three days per week in person.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the architecture, configuration, and ongoing administration of Okta, including SSO, MFA, authentication policies, group structure, and application integrations

 - Lead the ongoing Okta migration and integration of new and existing applications via SAML, OIDC, and SCIM

 - Design and build automated joiner, mover, and leaver workflows across HRIS, Okta, Google Workspace, MDM, and SaaS applications

 - Develop automation using Okta Workflows, REST APIs, and scripting to eliminate manual IT processes

 - Implement and maintain role-based access control, least-privilege access models, and periodic access reviews in partnership with the Security team

 - Integrate identity with endpoint management to support device trust and compliance enforcement

 - Support compliance requirements such as SOC 2 through access controls, audit evidence, and documentation

 - Write and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and architecture diagrams for identity and automation systems

 - Serve as an escalation point and technical resource for the IT Support team



REQUIREMENTS

 - 6+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, identity engineering, or a related role

 - Deep hands-on experience administering Okta, including Okta Identity Engine, Okta Workflows, authentication policies, and lifecycle management

 - Strong working knowledge of SAML, OIDC, SCIM, and MFA implementations

 - Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and experience working with REST APIs

 - Experience administering Google Workspace and an MDM platform (e.g. Kandji or Jamf)

 - Track record of designing and delivering automation that measurably reduced manual IT work

 - Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2

 - Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document systems for both technical and non-technical audiences



NICE TO HAVE

 - Okta certifications (Certified Professional, Administrator, or Consultant)

 - Experience managing identity or SaaS configuration as code (e.g. Terraform)

 - Experience with AWS IAM or cloud identity

 - Experience at a high-growth startup



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:

Samsara is looking for an experienced Technical Support Engineer to provide world-class hardware and software support experience to our customers. You will be a part of our Tier 2 support team within the umbrella of the Global Technical Support organization. You will be responsible for resolving complex customer problems and improving support across all teams. Your work will be collaborative in nature, working together with other support engineers in multiple support locations to serve our customers and troubleshoot complex issues.  

The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background with experience in a technical support role, proven customer-facing skills, and strong communication skills. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

title: Technical Account Engineer I
text:
Technical Account Engineer - I ( - Noida)

Sumo Logic helps companies keep applications reliable and secure. Our Technical Account Engineers are the people who make sure customers actually get value out of the platform, and they are the first point of contact for a portfolio of named post-sales accounts.

About the Role

Around 70% of the role is technical, hands-on-keyboard work: guiding customers through complex use cases, untangling deployment problems and showing practitioners how to get more out of the platform. The other 30% is building the kind of trust that makes you the first person customers call, whether that’s an engineer stuck on a query or a security lead thinking about renewal.

Our playbooks and automated health signals will give you a strong baseline, but at this level you’ll go well beyond them. You’ll know your named customers’ environments well enough to spot problems before they do and find the next use case before they ask. You’ll also design tailored plans when the standard play doesn’t fit, and bring in Support, Product, Engineering or Sales when a situation calls for it. You’ll help shape the playbooks themselves, and support Associate TAEs as they grow into the role.

You’ll have real visibility internally, including with senior leadership, and a genuine say in how we serve these customers.

What You Will Actually Do

Own your named accounts technically. Be the go-to technical lead for a portfolio of customers, and know their environments, priorities and risks inside out.

Get customers using the platform extensively. Build new use cases, bring in new data sources, teach advanced features and work through hard problems with security, DevSecOps and observability teams.

Craft success plans that can be measured. Understand what customers are trying to achieve, turn it into a technical plan, help them deliver it and expand it as the value shows up.

See trouble coming. Combine automated usage signals with your own judgement to spot adoption or technical risk early. Then pull the account team together to turn a wobbly account into an advocate.

Run the cadence. Lead health checks and contribute to Business Reviews, building credibility with practitioners, team leads and executive stakeholders.

Help the accounts grow. Work with Sales on renewals and expansion in a way that’s good for the customer and delivers additional value.

Make the team better. Feed customer insight back to Product and Engineering and improve our playbooks.

Where and When

This role is based in Noida, India, and candidates must be located in Noida.

Shifts are designed to overlap core Australia and New Zealand business hours.

You’ll join the local team in our Noida office from time to time, typically once a fortnight.

What You Will Bring

5 to 6 years in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, customer success engineering, professional services, solutions engineering, DevOps or SOC analysis.

Real production experience across enterprise infrastructure: operating systems, virtualisation, databases, networking and security.

Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).

SQL or query language skills, and the ability to look at usage data, work out what’s really going on and act on it.

A track record of owning multiple customer accounts and building relationships from practitioners to senior stakeholders.

Comfort with ambiguity: if something is unclear, you go and find out rather than waiting to be told.

A strong team player who collaborates across GTM functions and gets things done with no fuss.

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (B.Tech/BE or equivalent).

The Technical Stuff We Would Love to See

Experience with Observability or SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, Dynatrace, CrowdStrike, QRadar, Exabeam).

A background in alerting and monitoring in security, operations or DevSecOps settings.

text:
SOFTWARE ENGINEER – SYSTEMS & RELIABILITY

Smallest.ai http://Smallest.ai | Bangalore




ABOUT THE ROLE

Own a service or a part of our product from design through production. You’ll write the code, validate its behaviour, deploy it and keep it reliable for the customers who depend on it.

Testing, deployment and operations are part of engineering ownership here. You’ll work with the team, but you won’t hand off responsibility when your code is merged.

Our systems power real-time voice, where an extra 100 milliseconds can change how a conversation feels. Behind that experience are GPU inference workloads for text-to-speech and speech recognition across AWS regions, alongside multi-tenant APIs, concurrency controls, billing and webhooks.

We work with Python, TypeScript and Go on Kubernetes in AWS, supported by Redis, MongoDB-compatible stores, Postgres, ClickHouse, RabbitMQ and Temporal. Familiarity helps; understanding the mechanisms underneath matters more.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Define success before building. Establish measurable service-level objectives for customer-facing latency, availability and correctness.

 - Write maintainable code. Build systems another engineer can understand, debug and operate without depending on you being available.

 - Test beyond the happy path. Use unit, integration, load and fault-injection testing to validate behaviour under realistic conditions. Explain your coverage and its limitations in review.

 - Ship safely. Own CI, deployments, rollbacks, schema migrations and infrastructure changes. When your work requires a Terraform change, you own that too.

 - Operate what you build. Create useful dashboards, actionable alerts and runbooks. Participate in on-call, incident response and postmortems.

 - Stay close to customer impact. When calls drop or requests fail, investigate directly, communicate clearly and drive the issue to resolution.

 - Improve the system around the problem. Turn recurring incidents and manual debugging into better controls, automation and tooling.




THE CHALLENGES YOU’LL HELP SOLVE

Our product works, and we’re strengthening the reliability practices that support its next stage of growth.

 - Define SLOs for services that do not yet have clear reliability targets.

 - Replace misleading health signals with monitoring that reflects whether customers can complete their tasks.

 - Improve logging, health checks and alerting so failures are easier to detect and diagnose.

 - Make testing and operational readiness a consistent part of delivery.

 - Address existing reliability gaps alongside new product development.

You’ll fix problems you didn’t introduce and make decisions with incomplete information. You’ll also be expected to balance delivery speed with production readiness: surface risks early, propose practical trade-offs and follow through on commitments.





WHAT WE LOOK FOR

Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to apply them to unfamiliar problems. We assess these directly through technical discussion and practical reasoning.

You should be comfortable explaining and reasoning about:

 - Processes and operating systems: Process creation, signals, file descriptors, namespaces, cgroups, PID 1 behaviour and CPU throttling.

 - Memory: Virtual memory, page cache, available memory, swap, cgroup memory limits, out-of-memory behaviour and stalls that occur despite low CPU utilisation.

 - Files and storage: Inodes, durability and fsync, disk-usage discrepancies, atomic rename, IOPS and throughput.

 - Networking: TCP states, TIME_WAIT, connection and read timeouts, Nagle’s algorithm, delayed acknowledgements, DNS, TLS, NAT and the trade-offs of UDP for real-time media.

 - Concurrency and distributed systems: Race conditions, locks, idempotency, at-least-once delivery, retries, backoff, jitter, backpressure, clocks and partial failures.

title: Escalation Engineer
text:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
Role 

We are looking for a Escalation Engineer to join our team in a hybrid capacity based in Bangalore, reporting to the Senior Manager, Product Support within our Support department. The ideal candidate will function as the highest level of technical support within the TAC, responsible for resolving the most complex and critical issues escalated from Level I and Level II support engineers.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

Provide second line phone/email consultation to independently debug complex security/network problems

Interface with Engineering and assist the customer with testing or troubleshooting

Reproduce customer issues to verify problems and provide feedback to Engineering and Operations teams

Create entries in our technical support online database to accurately document any incident resolution that is not found in our knowledge base

Understand the product direction and customer use-cases and provide input on product & code changes through all points of the product cycle

Who You Are (Success Profile)

You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer—both internal and external—and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems. You champion their needs from start to finish, knowing their success is our success.

You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

Minimum 8-year experience working as Support Engineer/ Sr. Support Engineer supporting networking or web security products

Experience with operating systems such as Linux, Unix, and Free BSD

Experience troubleshooting network issues and familiarity with the necessary tools (Ping, Traceroute, MTR etc)

Expert knowledge of protocols such as HTTP, SMTP, FTP, DNS etc

Familiarity with Network Protocol Analyzers (tcpdump, Wireshark), Network Security (SSL/TLS, VPN
